method: Manual gridded measurement by Claude (+/-10 px) on outputs and on Version A/B references with the same method. Supporting evidence only (clothing, stance, rotation, perspective affect ratios).

8-1_front.caveats: Output waist measured over a fitted ribbed tank (fabric may add width); jeans add denim thickness at hips/thighs. Shoulder width equal across all three, so the scale is comparable.

8-2_three_quarter.status: POSE-LIMITED: output rendered near side-on (~80-90 deg) instead of the requested ~45 deg three-quarter view; depth ratios are not comparable with the 45-degree references, so no index is reported.
